BiblicalUsage: David pictures the floods of great waters that cannot reach the man who prays in time, Job hears of the watercourse cut for the overflowing of waters, and Daniel sees the end of the anointed one coming with a flood. The word is the rush of water that overwhelms everything in its path.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the flood is one of the Bible's truest pictures of judgment, because it cannot be argued with or outrun. I hold that the only safe ground in a flood is the hiding place David found, and that is why I pray to the God who holds the waters back.
